content.short: AtemReview is a decentralized content creation and social graph protocol that empowers creators to own their data and monetize social influence.
content.description: AtemReview is a leading decentralized social and content platform built to give creators full ownership over their data and community interactions. By utilizing a decentralized social graph, Atem allows users to build token-gated spaces and share content while directly monetizing their influence without intermediaries. Integrated with the Mantle Network, AtemReview leverages high scalability and low costs to provide a seamless and rewarding social experience for the Web3 community.
content.meta: AtemReview is a decentralized content creation and social graph protocol on Mantle. Discover AtemReview on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
